note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors of the Banbridge rural district, polled (had there been a contest) on Thursday 2 June 1927. All twenty elected members were returned without a contest: fifteen were nominated on nomination day, 4 May 1927, and no papers were lodged for the other five, whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. The Banbridge Chronicle's nomination-day report is the source. No paper lodged; the retiring member was deemed re-elected. Returned unopposed.
